logic.top_level: pathways: four procedures, each with its own Roman-numeral criteria block (I diagnostic, II general eligibility, III no contraindications), reusing near-identical sub-blocks

k_of_n.quote: Signs and symptoms - must satisfy at least one: 1. ... significant physical functional impairment 2. ... chronic or recurrent skin condition 3. ... significant pain or weakness
Unilateral disease - must satisfy at least one: a. Volumetry differential ... b. Bioimpedance (L-Dex) ... c. Lymphoscintigraphy

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Explicit NOT blocks: 'III. NONE of the following contraindications exist:' then transient lymphedema, lipedema without lymphatic dysfunction, and 'ANY of the following uncontrolled comorbidities' (DVT, CHF, pregnancy, dye anaphylaxis, active infection ...).
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Lipedema block requires staged expectations: 'strong likelihood that 2 or 3 procedures might be required'; no explicit repeat-procedure criteria.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Lymphedema therapy includes compression therapy (bandaging/garment/gauntlet) AND any of the following treatment modalities
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Compression required plus at least one of four modalities: an all(compression, any(4)) nested inside a definitional sentence of the leaf.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: C. Any of the following uncontrolled comorbidities: D. Venous disease ... E. Congestive heart failure
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: In the lymphovenous bypass block the comorbidities are lettered D-L continuing the parent list, so they look like siblings of 'C' rather than children.
Block II says A, B, C but the lymphovenous bypass block actually lists A-D; the stated letters do not match the items.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: D. Member has completed a course of conservative treatment ... E. Lymphedema therapy includes compression therapy
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: In the reductive block, E is a definition of D, not a separate requirement.

requirement_kinds.quote: significant physical functional impairment (such as: difficulty ambulating or performing activities of daily living)
Lymphoscintigraphy findings must show a minimum of a one-hour delayed transit time to first-level lymph nodes
Volumetry differential ... >10% (if affected extremity dominant extremity) or >7% (affected extremity is non-dominant extremity)
lymphedema therapy for a minimum of 20 hours/week for 6 months
Photographs are submitted documenting the affected extremities requested for treatment
Submission of a plan of care agreement signed by the member
evaluated by a surgeon who performs lymphatic surgery who determined they are a not a candidate for VLNT or lymphovenous bypass
MRI imaging findings consistent with moderate to severe fat hypertrophy

thresholds.quote: Bioimpedance (L-Dex) differential of at least 10 units
minimum of a one-hour delayed transit time

time_windows.quote: a minimum of 20 hours/week for 6 months
not persistent for at least six months post last oncologic treatment
Minimally responsive to at least 3 consecutive months of optimal medical management

codes.non_covered_code_lists: None; investigational scope is stated in prose only.

vague_terms.quote: significant pain or weakness in the affected extremity
Morbidly obese members must first complete a formal weight loss program
vague_terms.problem: 'morbidly obese' not defined here and 'formal program' unspecified.

vague_terms.quote: clinically significant such as rest pain, claudication or ischemic ulcers

extraction_hazards: Bullets are either the private-use character U+F0B7 or U+2022 depending on the document (the fusion guideline uses both), never '-' or '*'; nested bullets use other glyphs ('o') or only deeper indentation
Hyperlink navigation bar after the disclaimer is flattened into a 2-3 row text block that looks like headings
Form-feed (\f) page breaks can fall mid-list or immediately before a section heading, so '^HEADING' regexes can miss; no running headers/footers or page numbers to strip

Position Statement is a two-column table: left column holds procedure names, right column the criteria, and the right-column indent shifts between blocks (30 vs 22 vs 36 spaces), so nesting must be inferred, not read from indent
Headings 'Lipidema' is misspelled in text; 'DESCRIPTION:' is indented by one space so a strict ^DESCRIPTION regex fails
List lettering restarts or continues incorrectly (comorbidity list lettered D-L under C)
Billing section contains a clinical-guidance narrative (MRI use) that reads like criteria
Header block lines have a leading space
interesting_structures: Same I/II/III skeleton repeated four times with small edits (copy-paste family; BMI 35, 20 h/week for 6 months)
Dominant vs non-dominant arm threshold (10% vs 7%)
Unilateral vs bilateral disease branch changes which measurements count
Photographs and signed plan-of-care agreement as criteria
MRI guidance in Billing/Coding is functionally a criterion for reductive surgery

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = all/any/not expresses it cleanly ... 5 = needs new constructs or human judgment
fit_to_tree.why: Nested all/any/not fits well and is highly regular, but the table layout, wrong letter references and definitional sub-bullets make extraction error-prone, and several leaves need measurements most charts will not hold.
